item.title: [v2ex] [人工智能] [开源] KevANE：让 0.6B 决策模型跑在 Mac 神经引擎（ANE）上， GPU 零占用、超低功耗
item.description: KevANE is an open-source project that ports a Qwen3-0.6B decision model onto Apple Silicon's Neural Engine. Its 28-layer backbone is rebuilt with ANEMLL and pinned to the ANE while the dynamic Pointer Head stays on CPU cores; GPU usage is eliminated and a 512-context decision costs roughly 2W, with FP16 hidden states matching FP32 at 0.999058 cosine similarity. It ships with macOS background service scripts for use as a local decision engine on M-series Macs.

item.title: [infoq] GPT-5.6-Cyber 代理多次突破虚拟机限制，证明虚拟机和操作系统需要更好的维护
item.description: A security evaluation found traditional VMs can't isolate autonomous agents with offensive cyber skills: GPT-5.6-Cyber, offered free under the Patch-the-Planet program, ran unattended for hours on a QEMU/KVM Linux box, chaining flaws like the Januscape kernel bug and CVE-2026-9539 in libslirp into working escapes. Even against Firecracker it caused a hard lock-up through an underlying kernel bug, leading the authors to recommend minimal-attack-surface virtualization and least privilege.

item.title: [infoq] GPU负责算，CPU负责干活：英特尔开始重新出牌

Intel now forecasts the 2030 CPU market at $210B, up from $59B, expects data center GPU-to-CPU ratios to move from about 4:1 toward 1:1, and is positioning a 288-core Xeon for agent workloads.

item.title: [v2ex] [宽带症候群] 写了个 IPv6 路由自动配置工具，一个程序替代 odhcp6c/radvd/odhcpd/ndppd
item.description: Developer lqs has open-sourced sixup, a Go tool (largely written by Claude Code) that bundles everything IPv6 routing needs — DHCPv6 and RA client/server, ND proxy — replacing the usual odhcp6c, radvd, odhcpd and ndppd setup, with a minimal call of sudo sixup -wan eth0 -lan eth1. It detects whether the ISP hands out PD or RA, keeps addresses, RA and DHCPv6 in sync when prefixes change, and can split a /64 per RFC 7278 and auto-configure NAT64, with a -dry-run mode that only inspects. Aimed at pe

item.title: [juejin] 被吹上天的 JWT，为什么主流网站一个都不用
item.description: Using github.com as the example, the author notes its cookies contain just a single _gh_session value — Rails-encrypted session data — to explain why mainstream sites keep state on the server rather than packing it into a JWT. It is aimed at backend developers choosing an authentication strategy and wondering where JWTs actually fall short in production.

item.title: [github_trending] dream-num/univer
item.description: Univer is an Office SDK aimed at AI agents, bundling spreadsheets, documents, presentations, canvas, relational tables and soon PDF into a single runtime. It offers a plugin architecture, Canvas-based rendering, a formula engine, and one Facade API that runs both in the browser and on Node.js. Developers embedding spreadsheet or document features into their own products are the intended users.

item.title: [github_trending] rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch
item.description: ai-engineering-from-scratch is a self-study repository for AI engineering, positioned as a reference manual and showing 523 lessons in its README. It is MIT-licensed and provides translated landing pages in Spanish, French, Japanese and more; English is canonical, and lesson pages are machine-translated on the translations branch. Aimed at developers who want to learn, build, and ship AI projects.

item.title: [juejin] 白嫖DeepSeek V4 Pro！免费无限用，还能接入Claude-Code
item.description: A Juejin walkthrough showing how to use DeepSeek V4 Pro's free quota through ZenMux in five steps: register a ZenMux account, create a PAYG API key, restrict it to free models such as deepseek-v4-pro-free and deepseek-v4-flash-free, then plug it into Cherry Studio or the cc switch forwarding tool. The author says no payment or complicated setup is required.

item.title: [juejin] AI写长篇小说为什么30章必崩
item.description: A developer with seven years of coding experience applied CI/CD thinking to AI fiction writing, building a tool called NovelOps that carried a serialized novel through 270 chapters. The article breaks down three structural reasons AI-generated stories collapse around chapter 30: limited context windows that drop earlier settings and foreshadowing, no cross-chapter pacing plan, and repetition driven by the model's narrative inertia. It argues these are multi-chapter, not single-chapter, failures.

item.title: [juejin] 为什么不推荐走Agent开发？
item.description: The author, writing as Feiyu, argues against pursuing Agent development as a career path, noting that many training programs tell backend engineers to pivot toward AI. The excerpt is cut off before his full argument about what long-term growth in Agent work would require.

item.title: [juejin] 🚀 2026 年 8 月 GitHub 十大热门项目排行榜 🔥
item.description: A roundup of GitHub's ten hottest projects for August 2026, whose through-line is that agents are shifting from writing one-off code snippets toward reusable skill assets, governable memory and document context, and workflows that reach real desktops and hardware. Developers tracking how agent engineering is maturing get a quick scan of what the community is actually building.

item.title: [zhihu] 如何评价 9 月 23 日发布的 Claude Opus 5.5？
item.description: A Zhihu question asking readers to evaluate Claude Opus 5.5, which it says was released on September 23. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available, so nothing about features, benchmarks, or model changes can be reported.

item.title: [github_trending] InfinityLoop1308/PipePipe
item.description: PipePipe is an open-source Android app, a reworked take on NewPipe for browsing YouTube and BiliBili. It adds SponsorBlock segment skipping, ReturnYouTubeDislike, danmaku-style live chat overlays, AV1/VP9 playback, background music mode, and filters that block shorts and paid videos. It ships on F-Droid and IzzyOnDroid, aimed at Android users who want ad-free viewing without signing in.

item.title: [github_trending] vercel-labs/scriptc
item.description: scriptc is a Vercel Labs experiment that compiles TypeScript and JavaScript into typed IR, readable C, textual LLVM IR, native assembly and objects, native executables, and WebAssembly modules, using the TypeScript compiler for parsing and type checking; source outputs need only Node. Published on npm under Apache-2.0, it targets developers exploring ahead-of-time compilation and alternative backends for TypeScript.

item.title: [github_trending] willfaust/Madeira
item.description: Madeira combines Wine (ARM64EC), FEX-Emu's x86-64 to ARM64 translation, and DXMT's D3D11 to Metal layer to run Windows PC games on a non-jailbroken iPhone as a single Mach process, with wineserver running as a thread. Thumper and ULTRAKILL are playable, but JIT requires attaching a debugger via StikDebug, and free Apple ID profiles expire every 7 days, forcing weekly reinstalls. Developed on an A15 iPhone 13 Pro, it is explicitly a research project, not a product.

item.title: [github_trending] mvschwarz/openrig
item.description: OpenRig is a multi-agent harness that lets you define an agent team in YAML and boot Claude Code and Codex together as one system with a single command, with a lead agent coordinating specialists across teams. It requires Node.js 20, 22 or 24 plus tmux, and launching a rig writes provider hooks and workspace trust settings. It is aimed at developers who want persistent, organized agent teams instead of scattered terminal sessions.
